name: maanasa-docs-mcp
description: Documentation Model Context Protocol server for querying portfolio documentation pages, markdown content, and reference material.
instructions: This MCP server provides read-only access to documentation pages, markdown content, and reference material for Maanasa Narayan's portfolio site. Use search_doc_pages to find relevant documentation, read_doc_page to retrieve a specific page, and list_doc_resources to enumerate available documentation resources.

tools.name: search_doc_pages
tools.description: Search across all portfolio documentation pages, markdown content, and LLM context files by keyword or topic.

query.description: The search query term or topic to find in documentation

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 50)

tools.name: read_doc_page
tools.description: Retrieve the full markdown text content of a specific documentation page by its path.

path.description: The path to the document page (e.g. "/about", "/llms.txt", "/auth.md", "/developers", "/privacy")

tools.name: list_doc_resources
tools.description: List all available documentation resources and pages with their paths, titles, and content types.
